dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: When did your neck pain begin?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Two days ago after I slept in an awkward position.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: Yesterday you could barely turn your head.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He took ibuprofen last night because the neck was very uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: A little. The pain improved, but the neck still feels stiff.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you also had a headache?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I have a mild headache mainly at the back of my head.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: We checked his temperature twice and there has been no fever.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: He turns his whole body when he wants to look sideways.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Any numbness, tingling, or weakness in either arm or hand?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No numbness, no tingling, and no weakness in either arm.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did you have any accident, fall, or injury before the neck pain started?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. There was no injury. I simply woke up with the stiff neck.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He was using a different pillow that night.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: All right. I will examine the neck movement, muscles, strength, and sensation and check for any warning signs.
